name: planbee
description: Manage maintenance work in PlanBee: equipment, maintenance tasks and incidents, with photos.

interface.longDescription:
PlanBee helps maintenance teams keep their equipment running. Ask in plain language to look up equipment and check its condition, list and create maintenance tasks, report incidents, follow how they were resolved and what they cost, and attach photos to any of them. You can also search an equipment manual, read the maintenance notes of a place or a piece of equipment, check when a job was last done and whether its warranty is still active, set up and review rounds and inspections, assign work to the staff and see what each person has pending, keep track of spare parts and supplies and what needs to be bought, see which supplier to call for each kind of work and compare the repair quotes they sent, see how maintenance costs evolve month by month, find equipment by its QR label, and turn the account of a work shift into logged incidents plus a handover note. Service companies can also put together a repair quote from the price list and review their quotes; the quote is saved in PlanBee and sent to the client from the app. To organize bigger jobs (a renovation, getting a kitchen ready for the season), create a project and follow its tasks, equipment, milestones and budget. Setting up is quick too: create the places of a hotel, restaurant or house (floors, rooms, kitchens) in one go, and copy a piece of equipment when you have several identical ones.

PlanBee works on the organizations of your connected PlanBee account. Every result and every action respects your role and permissions in that organization: you only see and change what you could see and change inside the PlanBee app.

A PlanBee account is required. Invoicing, sending quotes to clients, finances, subscription management and deleting equipment, projects or places are not available here and are handled inside the PlanBee app.

defaultPrompt: Show me the latest maintenance tasks.
Which equipment needs attention right now?
Log an incident: the dishwasher isn't drying properly.

positive.prompt: Show me the latest maintenance tasks.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the most recent maintenance tasks of the test organization with their status and priority. On clients that render plugin UI they are also shown as task cards.

positive.description: Find a known piece of equipment by name. The equipment in the test organization is named in Spanish ("Cámara refrigerada", a walk-in cooler).
positive.prompt: Show me the status of the Cámara refrigerada.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the matching equipment and reports its operational status, criticality and location, plus any open tasks or incidents on it.

positive.description: Compare the repair quotes received for a problem. The test organization has an open incident "La freidora sobrecalienta el aceite" (the fryer overheats the oil) with two quotes from suppliers, and a supplier list (requires the finance module, enabled in the test organization).
positive.prompt: The fryer is overheating the oil. What quotes did we get to fix it, and who else could we call?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the fryer incident, lists the two quotes received (Gastro Técnica and Frío Sur Refrigeración) with their amount, what they found and the estimated duration, and lists the suppliers that cover fryers with their contact person and email. It does not approve any quote: that is done in the PlanBee app.

positive.prompt: Log an incident: the dishwasher isn't drying properly.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an open incident in the test organization and confirms its initial status and risk level.

positive.description: Assign work to a member of the staff. The test organization has two staff members: Martín Pérez (air conditioning and refrigeration) and Laura Gómez (plumbing and electrical).
positive.prompt: Create a task to fix the leaking sink in the kitchen and assign it to Laura.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Laura Gómez in the staff list (name, role and kinds of work only, no email or phone), says who will get the task, and creates it assigned to her.

negative.description: Deleting equipment is not available through this plugin. It should explain that and not call a write tool.
negative.prompt: Delete the vertical freezer from the system.

negative.description: Data from an organization the connected account does not belong to must not be returned.
negative.prompt: Show me the assets of an organization I'm not a member of.

negative.description: Invoicing and subscription management are outside this plugin. It may look at maintenance records, but it must state that invoices and the subscription plan are not available here and must not invent figures.
negative.prompt: What did we invoice last month and what's our subscription plan?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds assigning work to the staff, spare parts and suppliers. See the members of the organization with their role and the kinds of work they do (never their email or phone), assign or reassign tasks, incidents, rounds and inspections, and see what each person has pending. Keep track of spare parts and supplies: what is in stock, what was used and what needs to be bought. When something breaks, see which supplier to call for that kind of work or brand, with their business contact, add or correct suppliers, and compare the repair quotes received for each incident.

es-ES.subtitle: Gestioná el mantenimiento
es-ES.description:
PlanBee ayuda a los equipos de mantenimiento a tener sus equipos funcionando. Pedí en lenguaje natural consultar equipos y su estado, listar y crear tareas de mantenimiento, reportar incidencias, ver cómo se resolvieron y cuánto costaron, y adjuntar fotos. También podés buscar en el manual de un equipo, leer las indicaciones de mantenimiento de un lugar o equipo, ver cuándo se hizo un trabajo por última vez y si su garantía sigue vigente, armar y revisar recorridas e inspecciones, repartir el trabajo entre el personal y ver qué tiene pendiente cada uno, llevar el stock de repuestos y materiales y saber qué hay que comprar, ver a qué proveedor llamar para cada trabajo y comparar los presupuestos de reparación que mandaron, ver cómo evolucionan los costos de mantenimiento mes a mes, encontrar un equipo por su etiqueta QR y convertir el relato de un turno en incidencias cargadas y un parte para el turno siguiente. Las empresas de servicio técnico también pueden armar un presupuesto de reparación con su lista de precios y revisar sus presupuestos; el presupuesto queda guardado en PlanBee y se le envía al cliente desde la app. Para organizar trabajos más grandes (una reforma, poner a punto la cocina para la temporada), creá una obra y seguí sus tareas, equipos, hitos y presupuesto. También es rápido armar todo: creá de una vez los lugares de un hotel, restaurante o casa (pisos, habitaciones, cocinas) y copiá un equipo cuando tenés varios iguales.

PlanBee trabaja sobre las organizaciones de tu cuenta de PlanBee conectada. Cada resultado y cada acción respeta tu rol y tus permisos: solo ves y cambiás lo mismo que podrías ver y cambiar dentro de la app.

Se necesita una cuenta de PlanBee. La facturación, el envío de presupuestos al cliente, las finanzas, la suscripción y el borrado de equipos, obras y lugares no están disponibles acá: se manejan dentro de la app.
